name: Veil Masquerade #12
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Plume and beads. Aperture: Twin slits. Ornament: Lightning. Palette: Gold + teal. Hem: Beaded fringe. Its hem is shared with 2 others in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
